answer: Karst Groundwater Residency Audit. Each agent identity must present a live sensor trace from a mapped karst aquifer whose mineral signature varies by cave chamber. A single operator cannot fake many distinct physical chambers, since forgery requires physically occupying each one. An ember of a trace replayed from one chamber fails cross-chamber checks. Maintaining N identities costs N field deployments and continuous extraction rights, an oasis of cost no cheap script can replicate.
